'''Virtual Block 3''' is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The '''September 2009''' hub Date is the Block '''reorganization''' date, not the first print year of every card. On 16 September 2009 the Players Committee announced completion of Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV together with a realignment of the existing virtual sets (Virtual Sets 1–18) into thematic Virtual Blocks (contemporaneous secondary sources also summarize this as August 2009).<ref name="reorg2009">https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/</ref> Constituent cards were originally released across 2002–2009 as Virtual Sets 1–18.

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.
